page.overview:
Who is Eric the Red-Eye?

He appears as the main antagonist in the episode "Northern Lights Out", and leads a group of high-tech Vikings from Norway. He uses his Hammer of Thor as a weapon. and refers to himself as the "Son of Thor". Eric is eventually defeated by , who disrupts his Hammer of Thor (which is actually a holographic laser) by sending its own frequency back at it.
